name: Pocket Monsters
description: Bank one of every villager type in a single town hall. Gotta recruit 'em all.

name: Full Employment
description: Have every specialist villager — merchant, guard, innkeeper, mason, farmer and miner — working in your town.

name: Duck Customer
description: Sell grapes and lemonade at the same stall. "Got any grapes?"

name: Breakfast Club
description: Sell pancakes and an omelette at the same stall. The most important meal of the day.

name: Sweet and Savoury
description: Sell pizza and ice cream at the same stall. No judgement here.

name: Cornucopia
description: Sell eight different kinds of goods through one stall.

name: Diamond Hands
description: Fill a storage to the brim with diamonds.

name: Wormhole
description: Link a send pad and a receive pad on the same teleporter channel.
